annotations.title: Web fetch: get a URL as clean text

description: Web fetch for agents: fetch any public URL and get the page's main content as clean text or Markdown (headings, links, tables and code blocks kept), up to 100,000 characters; static HTML, Markdown and text pages. Bot walls, empty pages and errors are never charged. Use to read a web page, article or documentation URL into an LLM's context or a RAG pipeline. Example: url=https://example.com. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

format.description: Returned representation: text (default), markdown, or both

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of body text to return (500-100000, default 20000)

section.description: Optional exact visible HTML ID within the main content, 1-500 characters

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to scrape

name: web_fetch
title: Web fetch: get a URL as clean text
